messages:
lina-cs: FYI customer 'AcmeCorp' (org_id org_0xACME) says promo ACME-TRIAL-2026 applied but credits showing up on Hosted sku. They expected Dedicated capacity. Please triage.

alex-billing: Oof. Can you paste the apply_promo response/log? Need txn id + org_id.

lina-cs: txn: tx_98765, here's API response we got:
```json
{"status":"success","txn_id":"tx_98765","org_id":"org_0xACME","applied_sku":"hosted_standard","promo_code":"ACME-TRIAL-2026","promo_meta":{"target_sku":"dedicated_8x","grant_type":"reserved_capacity"}}
```

sara-infra: @alex-billing @mike-eng looks like promo service honored the promo but mapped to `hosted_standard`. Could be fallback logic in promo-mapper. :eyes:

alex-billing: Opening internal billing ticket BL-5043. Assigning to me. Customer impact: can't spin up dedicated nodes with reserved credits; currently tokens available on hosted only.

mike-eng: Can we move the credit entitlements server-side? Quick fix: update entitlements row to dedicated_8x and emit audit event. SQL I ran in staging:
```sql
UPDATE entitlements
SET sku='dedicated_8x', updated_by='ops_adjust'
WHERE org_id='org_0xACME' AND promo_code='ACME-TRIAL-2026';
```
Need DB write window and approval.

toni-ops: We need sign-off from billing and security. Also verify no double-apply (hosted credit should be removed). Suggest scripted migration: create reversal for hosted entries then apply dedicated entitlement.

alex-billing: Approving migration. @sara-infra can you queue the change during low traffic? Also add audit record with txn tx_98765.

sara-infra: Scheduling for 01:40 UTC. Will run migration script and post logs. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Incident ticket BL-5043 created. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BL-5043

lina-cs: Please keep me posted. Customer is sensitive about downtime; they'll wait for confirmation after migration. Thanks.

mike-eng: Root cause note: promo-mapper defaults to hosted if SKU feature-flag missing. I'll open PR to require explicit sku mapping in the promo manifest. ETA: today EOD. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/promo-mapper/pull/112

alex-billing: After migration confirm customer's Dedicated capacity shows reserved credits and no hosted balance. Post-checklist: 1) audit event 2) billing reconcile 3) notify customer.

sara-infra: Migration done. Logs:
```text
migration:start tx_98765
revoke: hosted_standard entries 3 tokens
apply: dedicated_8x entries 3 tokens
migration:success
```

alex-billing: Verified with billing ledger. Hosted balance removed, dedicated entitlement created. Notifying customer now. :tada:

lina-cs: Customer confirmed they can provision. Closing thread once they ack invoice. Thanks everyone.
